summary: Personal Assets Trust plc is a closed ended multi asset mutual fund launched and managed by Troy Asset Management Limited. The fund invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It benchmarks its performance against the FTSE All-Share Index. Personal Assets Trust plc was launched in 1983, and is domiciled in United Kingdom.
summary_fr: Personal Assets Trust plc est un fonds commun de placement multi-actifs à capital fixe lancé et géré par Troy Asset Management Limited. Le fonds investit sur les marchés d'actions et de titres à revenu fixe du monde entier. Il compare sa performance à l'indice FTSE All-Share. Personal Assets Trust plc a été lancée en 1983 et est domiciliée au Royaume-Uni.
